SourceProxy.name: VertexGlyph
SourceProxy.label: Vertex Glyph

Documentation.short_help: Create a vertex cell for every point
Documentation.long_help: Creates a vtkVertex cell for every point in the input polydata. Use this when the standard Points representation does not display a point cloud that has no cells (e.g. a PLY file with only vertex elements).

SourceProxy.Documentation: Creates a vtkVertex cell for every point in the input polydata. This is useful for point clouds loaded from formats such as PLY that only contain vertex positions and no cells, so that the standard Points representation can render them.
